caption: The drawing depicts a hand fan, opened and shown from the front. The body of the fan is light brown with evenly spaced folds, and it has a handle section in a slightly darker shade with decorative detailing at the closed end. The fan's surface features a painted design composed of several small birds in shades of blue, gray, and white, perched on thin brown branches. Among the branches are pink and white flowers, as well as green and purple leaves. Attached to the bottom of the handle is a thin, dark red cord that ends in a tassel with a couple of beads. The fan is centered on a plain, off-white background.
title: Fan
